auditors.confidence_note: No access to scorer/dataset/calendar internals; history[-1] is consumed on bar close and no state carries future-dated values, but I cannot verify the harness's per-bar view guarantee beyond reading the source.

All views coherently reject (gate p=0.872 vs. null-max 5% quantile 0.277; BH/Holm/uncorrected 0 discoveries; deflation margin -0.063) and the best candidate rests on 384 sessions / 182 downside sessions / 359 trades, not a degenerate denominator; what I could not see is the per-session return concentration (the reported kurtosis of 43.6 and skew of 4.1 hint at heavy concentration) and the number of prior campaigns run before this one.

Net P&L is positive (531.7 pts / ~$10.6k), commission is 11.9% of gross and not decisive, per-trade edge of ~1.48 pts ($29.64) comfortably exceeds the 0.2 pt round-trip commission, holding period (~6.7 min) and trade frequency (359 trades/384 sessions, one per session by design) are plausible for NQ opening-window entries; the module docstring matches the code (short-only, rally-then-reverse, symmetric stop/target) and stays inside the guardrail; however the score is quite modest (0.125) and no out-of-sample or per-trade distribution evidence was provided, so robustness of the pattern is hard to gauge.

reasons: By hour UTC, all profit comes from just two hours: hour 22 contributes 284.05 and hour 23 contributes 285.18, while hour 00 loses -37.53 and no other hours appear. Net ~531 total vs 569 from hours 22-23 alone — effectively 100%+ of gross profit is generated in a 2-hour window with no stated reason for why that window should persist.

By weekday, Sunday alone accounts for 396.2 of the ~531.7 total (74% of all profit), with Mon/Tue contributing smaller positives and Wed/Thu negative — the result is a Sunday-effect strategy in disguise, not a broad pattern.

By month, 2025-04 alone contributes 301.3 of ~531.7 total (57% of all profit). Removing that single month drops the total from 531.7 to ~230.4, and combined with the -93.7 and -72.5 losses in adjacent months, the monthly profile is dominated by one spike rather than consistent accrual.

Outcomes report 11 'crashed' against 89 'completed' (11% crash rate on the tracked subset), and this tracked subset covers only 100 of the 359 trades — the outcome distribution is either materially adverse or incompletely measured, and no explanation is offered for what 'crashed' means or why 11% is tolerable.

The profit_concentration_top5pct field is redacted and thus unavailable for the axis most directly about tail concentration; the reader cannot verify whether a small number of trades drove the result.
auditors.confidence_note: The campaign winner's own trade-level distribution (per-trade P&L, per-session P&L) is not provided, and the redacted top-5% concentration figure means I cannot confirm or rule out single-trade dependence beyond what the hourly/weekday/monthly breakdowns already show.
